assertion_analysis.fails_if: x64 configuration is absent; runtime configuration check.
Uniform array drives differ from the existing scalar driver in certification, moments, reached drive, counts, requested drives or steps; changing only lane growth/history breaks agreement.
Sharing acceptance or the minimum step removes [True,False], the easy-lane growth, earlier arrival, held target or zero subsequent updates; recorded mutant returns 0.005 instead of 0.02.
Broadcasting a single target or direction produces incorrect solved cubic roots, reached drives or fresh residuals; updating a stationary lane violates zero update observation.

Only one update occurs, cached branch is never executed, or cached Newton uses lane zero profile; runtime callbacks must observe both 0.25 and -0.75 and one refactor per lane. Wrong cached-profile mutant fails.

Restoring first-trial result leakage exposes moments/positions shifted by 100, certifies a rejected lane, loses warm support, or marks absent support available; floor and ceiling variants cover both exits.

Whole-batch acceptance, unconditional result replacement or rejected support retention loses the independently expected accepted lane value 2, incumbent value 1, positions, availability or missing-read NaN.

Dropping lane_indices from rebuild_trial raises expected-3/got-2; rebuilding at the trial instead of incumbent changes observed builds; wrong lane profile prevents expected roots; failure to redo the first correction changes literal [1,1] refactors and [3,3] reads.
Dtype or backend is wrong, continuation does not certify, or any reported fresh residual exceeds 1e-10.

Arms use different inputs, ratios exceed the independent bounds, the four over-bound synthetic controls fail to refuse, eight finite certified residuals are absent, or aggregate reads/updates disagree with the sum of per-call maxima.
Reconstructed accepted drives fail to reach target, allocation/reproduction is incomplete, suite receipt is incomplete/nonzero, negative control does not fail, or a first measured trial is rejected.
The archived shared-driver premise no longer exhibits easy success with stiff failure and whole-batch shrink.
Shared-step mutation marker is absent/ambiguous, mutant is green, paired run is incomplete or adds a failure, or head lane tests fail.
A shared-step or cached-profile mutation cannot be uniquely placed, fails to produce a failure, or paired completed files gain failures.
Updated driver gates fail or are incomplete, mutation placement is ambiguous, or the shared-step control passes.
The rebuild mutation is not unique, paired common files are incomplete/add failures, either head lane file fails, or the two-item mutant passes.

assertion_independence_note: No unconditional input-echo assertion found: expected target roots are checked against Newton-computed moments, incumbent values differ deliberately from rejected trials, and cached profiles are observed inside the runtime branch. Growth/shrink checks share the configured constants and do not lock their numerical defaults, but the independently failing shared-step mutant establishes the scheduling guard.
